content:
Evidence from the datasheet: the eight `λC0`–`λC7` rows in **Optical Characteristics** and **Receiver Optical Specifications** each define one min/center/max wavelength set. Per-lane limits use **AOPL** max **5.3 dBm**, **AOPR** max **5.3 dBm**, and **SOMA** **−7.1 dBm**; **SRS** **−4.7 dBm** is a separate row (Note 2, stressed conformance). There is a single orderable part (**LQD-LW400-LR8C**), no amplified path, and no penalty objects in the input. **400** / **425 Gbps** and **13.2 dBm** total launch are module-level aggregates, not on the same table row as a single lane wavelength—so they are not split into extra modes without guessing. **LR8** vs **400GBASE-LR8** is the same application; **6.3 dBm** is **AOPD** (damage), not **AOPR** overload.
